section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Suspension
title: Strut Bar

content.description: Diagram showing strut bar attached to bracket with nut

items:
REMOVE STRUT BAR FROM BRACKET
Remove the nut and strut bar from the bracket.

content.text: Do not remove the staked nut.

content.description: Diagram showing strut bar connected to lower arm with bolt, showing jacking point

items:
REMOVE STRUT BAR FROM LOWER ARM
Jack up the lower arm and disconnect the strut bar. Remove the bolt holding the strut bar to the lower arm and disconnect the strut bar.

content.description: Diagram showing measurement of 369.1 mm distance for staked nut adjustment

items:
ADJUST STAKED NUT
Check that the distance between the staked nut and center of the bolt hole is 369.1 mm (14.531 in.). Adjust staked nut as necessary.

content.text: Do not move staked nut unless required.

content.description: Diagram showing strut bar being connected to lower arm with bolt and torque wrench

items:
CONNECT STRUT BAR TO LOWER ARM
Connect the strut bar to the lower arm with a bolt. Torque the bolt.

content.component: Strut bar to lower arm bolt

content.description: Diagram showing strut bar being connected to bracket with nut

items:
CONNECT STRUT BAR TO BRACKET
Connect the strut bar to the bracket with a nut. Torque the nut.

CHECK FRONT WHEEL ALIGNMENT AND SIDE SLIP
(See page FA-3)
